(to the question) The YH of Elokim
The expansion of the thirty-two paths of Hochma within the fifty gates of Bina — that is, in the phase of Katnut, where there is as yet no revelation but the phase of the five Gevurot of the Katnut of Ima — is discerned as the phase of the YH of Elokim. For the Katnut of Ima is the Name Elokim, and the phase of the Yod is the drop of the male waters of Aba included in it, and the Hey is the phase of the trace of the five Gevurot of the Katnut that is revealed in ZA by its means. But in the phase of the pregnancy of ZA, when there is not yet even the expansion of the fifty gates of Bina of Katnut, since the coarseness is in the phase of the root, it is discerned that only the letters ALEM of Elokim have been revealed there, and not the YH, which indicate the aforementioned expansion. See answer 14. (Page 225, Item 253; and in Ohr Pnimi, s.v. ALEM).
